authority.catalog_scope_limit_disclosure: This experiment is catalog-wide only within the archived Starlink payload; it is not an all-satellite search.

multi_radio_frame_ledger.evaluation_response: normalized_odd_cfo_hz on the identical even-selected mask
multi_radio_frame_ledger.upstream_conditioning: Previously opened source branches were selected with persisted all-Qin products; this is retrospective development evidence, not an untouched acquisition holdout.

long_150802_ledger.upstream_conditioning: The 550 direct-GLRT rows are a frozen hindsight-associated branch and do not separate even-Qin membership from odd-Qin response.

tle_inputs.selection_rule: exact committed binding below; each retrieved_at must strictly precede the first measurement UTC

observer_and_geometry.candidate_membership: all SGP4-usable, altitude-plausible Starlinks above the geometric horizon at any actual measurement time
observer_and_geometry.interpretation: Geometry is conditional on the reviewed site preset; horizon visibility is not beam visibility.

measurement_reduction.path_weighting: equal path mean squared error, not raw-row pooling
measurement_reduction.missing_evaluation_response: retained in failure ledger and excluded from numerical RMS denominator

baseline_fixed_time_free_offset.fitted_terms: one training-only constant CFO offset per path

primary_hierarchical_receiver_nuisance.fitted_terms: one training-only constant CFO offset per path and one regularized rate departure per physical radio
primary_hierarchical_receiver_nuisance.ridge_penalty_scale: equal-path training MSE plus mean squared radio departure divided by prior variance

radio_only_nulls: path offsets plus one shared linear coefficient
path offsets plus shared linear and quadratic coefficients
diagnostic_overfit_models: TLE plus unregularized common affine departure

evaluation.primary_split: first 60 percent of UTC bins trains identity and nuisance; final 40 percent is scored once
evaluation.heldout_statistic: unpenalized equal-path RMS on responses never used by the fit
evaluation.wrong_time_control: repeat the full visible-catalog winner search at every matched field and compare best penalized training RMS; empirical p=(1+controls at least as compatible)/(1+40)
evaluation.permutation_control: independently permute 20 ms training bins within paths, repeat the full true-time candidate search, and use empirical p=(1+permutations at least as compatible)/(1+20)
evaluation.recurrence_unit: unique capture_session_id, never the duplicate 150802 diagnostic bundle

recovered_track: causal TLE digest and pre-measurement collection gate pass
at least two geometric-horizon candidates are scored
all training-only fit and heldout metrics are finite
candidate_evidence: primary hierarchical heldout RMS is at least 20 Hz better than the quadratic radio-only null
winner agrees between fixed-time free-offset baseline and hierarchical model
winner is unchanged in all three rolling-origin fits
bounded-clock optimum is interior and its winner equals the tau=0 winner
secure_norad: all recovered-track and candidate-evidence gates pass
the same NORAD passes candidate-evidence gates in at least two independent capture_session_ids
no TLE, observer, RF-frequency, path identity, or nuisance-boundary provenance failure

counting.baseline_track_recovery_count: recovered tracks under the fixed-time free-offset baseline
counting.primary_track_recovery_count: recovered tracks under the hierarchical receiver model
counting.secure_norad_count: unique NORAD IDs passing the complete recurrence gate
